root_cause: git archive honors per-user/repository tar.umask. Committed PDF packaging files inherited mode 0664 while candidate overlays were 0644, making source bundles environment-dependent.
fix: Pass git -c tar.umask=0022 for the archive operation, preserving executable and symlink semantics without changing repository configuration.
baseline: The new regression fails for all three hostile/different repository settings (0000,0002,0077) and byte reproducibility before the fix.
qualification: 116 orchestration tests pass with -W error. Regression checks exact file, executable, directory and symlink modes and byte-identical archives across all three settings.
